© THE DIFFERENCE
(WDX® — 02)
HYPA.Est. 2023

We are not an AI website startup.
We are an agency that did it the hard way first.

Hypa has been running since 2023. For three years we have built brands the traditional way — strategy, photography and video production, paid media, PR, events. Retained clients on monthly agreements, real campaigns with real budgets, and the kind of accountability that comes from a client who can leave at the end of any month.

That is the part the AI website companies do not have. They have a template library, a subscription and a support inbox. No client roster you can check, no body of work with names attached, nobody who will get on a call with you.

We are bringing AI to the front of what we do because it genuinely changes what a website costs to make, and pretending otherwise would be dishonest. But the judgement underneath it — knowing what a restaurant needs that a dentist does not, what makes someone actually pick up the phone — took three years of client work to learn. That has not been automated, and it is still the part that decides whether your site does anything for you.

(WDX® — 04)
HYPA.Positioning

Don’t let someone sell you an overpriced website in 2026.

A real agency with real-world knowledge is now using AI to build them at a fraction of the cost. We removed the part that was slow, not the part that was good.

The expensive part of a website was never the website. It was the discovery workshops, the account manager, the mood boards, six weeks of back-and-forth and the studio rent. What is left is judgement — knowing what a restaurant’s site needs that a dentist’s does not, and what actually makes someone pick up the phone. That comes from running retained client accounts, not from a template marketplace, and it is still done by people.

So why $499 and not $990?

Because $990 is the honest price and we are not pretending otherwise. What we are doing for the next 30 days is building a portfolio of this specific product, in sectors and countries we want to show work in. You are getting the introductory rate because you are early, not because the work is worth less.

Which means, plainly: a fixed price that is half what we market it at, a full month to change your mind with every dollar back, and an hour of our time on a call at handover. There is nothing to lose here and a working website to gain. The window closes 26 September 2026.
